notes: ACCESS: https://www.castlery.com/robots.txt fetched FIRST via probe.fetch (HTTP 200, chrome120, 323 bytes). Complete file: a single `User-agent: *` group with `Disallow: */wishlist$`, `Disallow: */checkout/`, `Disallow: */account/` and five per-locale sitemap lines. NO Claude / ClaudeBot / anthropic-ai / Claude-Web group, no Crawl-delay, no query-string disallow. All my requests were to allowed paths (/sg, /sg/sitemap, /sg/sitemap.xml, /us/sitemap.xml, /sg/accessories/mirrors and its two children, one ?page=2 probe); I touched no wishlist, checkout or account path. PER-HOST: everything lives on the single host www.castlery.com - the PLPs are server-rendered Next.js App Router pages carrying their own Algolia payload inline, so no separate API or sitemap host was contacted and none needed its own robots check. TREE: taken from the site's OWN published navigation, in two independent sources that agree. (1) The HTML sitemap at https://www.castlery.com/sg/sitemap gives the complete merchandised taxonomy - EIGHT departments and nothing else: Sofas (11 nodes), Tables (7), Chairs (6), Beds (9), Storage (4), Furniture Sets (3), Outdoor (7), Accessories (13: All Accessories, Rugs, Dinnerware, Cutlery Sets, Glassware, Wall & Standing Mirrors, Lighting & Lamps, Cushions, Sofa Accessories, Bed Accessories, Scented Candles, Care Kits, Vases and Vessels). There is no Bathroom, Bath, Bathroom Accessories, Bathroom Storage or Bath Linen department, and no such node hangs off any of the eight. (2) The XML sitemap https://www.castlery.com/sg/sitemap.xml was pulled in full - 1,825 en-SG URLs, of which 1,216 are /sg/products/ PDPs and 401 are non-product pages including 130 category/facet URLs. I did NOT conclude from the mega-menu alone: I enumerated every /sg category URL in the XML sitemap that the HTML sitemap does not list (the orphan layer - e.g. /accessories/throws, /accessories/pillow-cases, /accessories/cash-carry-accessories, /accessories/mirrors/floor-mirrors, /accessories/mirrors/wall-mirrors, /accessories/lighting/floor-lamps, /rugs/large-rugs, /storage/bar-cabinets, the colour and size facet pages under /sofas, /chairs, /tables) and none of them is bathroom-related. ABSENCE EVIDENCE (rule 36): a case-insensitive sweep of ALL 1,825 en-SG sitemap URLs - categories AND all 1,216 product URLs - for bath|toilet|shower|basin|sink|vanit|washroom|sanitar|towel|soap|lavat|bidet|faucet|tap returned ZERO hits. The only tokens from the bathroom vocabulary that appear anywhere on the SG site are 'mirror' (the decor mirror nodes above, plus four blog articles: feng-shui-mirror-placement, how-to-decide-mirror-size, mirror-ideas-for-your-home, mirror-or-art) and 'cabinet' (Sideboards & Buffet Cabinets and Bar Cabinets, both already in Furniture.xlsx as living/dining storage, not bathroom vanity units). Castlery sells no bathroom fixtures, baths, showers, enclosures, taps, sanitaryware, vanity units, bathroom cabinets, bathroom storage, bathroom accessories or bath linen. This is a genuine, evidenced absence, NOT an access failure - every page I requested returned HTTP 200. DEDUP (OPTION 1): already_extracted() run on every candidate. The index holds 38 castlery.com URLs, all en-SG: 33 from Furniture.xlsx (sofas, tables, chairs, beds, storage, outdoor, furniture sets) and 5 from Final.xlsx (accessories/dinnerware, /glassware, /lighting, /mirrors, /scented-candles). /sg/accessories/mirrors is a DIRECT hit, so the one node rules 10/11 might otherwise have pulled into Bathroom is already extracted and stays where it is; its two children are covered by that parent under blind spot (a) and are in review. Blind spots (b) and (c) checked because Castlery is multi-locale: the site serves /us, /sg, /au, /ca, /uk off ONE host with hreflang alternates between them, there is no separate country domain, and the exclusion index contains ZERO non-/sg/ castlery URLs - so there is no locale-variant or cross-host alias that could hide an already-extracted bathroom node. As a robustness check I also pulled the en-US sitemap (1,752 URLs) and swept it for the same bathroom tokens: 0 hits there too, confirming the absence is a property of the catalogue and not of the SG locale. QTY: no quantity is recorded because no row is recorded. The figures cited in review come from the Algolia `nbHits` embedded in each PLP's own inline payload (32 / 11 / 20); for the two children nbHits equals the number of product handles actually rendered (11 of 11, 20 of 20), which is the equivalence check. For the parent only 24 of 32 render on page 1 and ?page=2 re-serves page 1 unchanged, so I did not attempt any pagination arithmetic there. EXCLUDED with reason: Accessories > Bed Accessories, Pillow Cases, Throws, Cushions -> bedding/soft furnishing Textile, no bathroom context; Accessories > Care Kits -> furniture care and cleaning kits (leather/fabric/wood care), not bathroom cleaning accessories; Accessories > Vases, Scented Candles -> Decor, already in Final.xlsx; Accessories > Lighting & Lamps -> Lighting, already in Final.xlsx; Storage > Sideboards & Buffet Cabinets, Bar Cabinets, Shelves & Bookcases -> general Furniture/Storage already in Furniture.xlsx, rules 30-33 and OPTION 1 keep them there; Beds > Dressers & Chest of Drawers -> a bedroom dresser, not a bathroom vanity unit, and already in Furniture.xlsx; /sg/all-products, /sg/new, /sg/sale and the per-department bestsellers/new-in/sale nodes -> View All and promotional pages banned by rule 25.
